leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a notification context service to manage notification state across components.
Initialize notification state with default values for messages and visibility.
Implement methods to add and remove notifications from the context.
Configure a component to inject and consume the notification context.
Bind notification data from the context to the component's template.
Control notification display by updating context state from user interactions.
Integrate the notification context into multiple components to share state.
